messages:
alyssa: Deploybot paused the promotion during the change window. deploy-bot reported: artifact index lookup failed and smoke tests 3/5 infra flakes. see the job: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=artifact_index_missing, affected_artifacts=[webui:sha256:abc123], suggested_action=retry-or-manual-pin
alyssa: copy of the failing logs:
```
WARN lookup: index key not found: artifacts/webui/sha256:abc123
ERROR smoke-test: failed to start testdb (connection timeout)
```
alyssa: this is blocking the release cut. we can either wait for the index propagation (cache write TTL is 60s usually) or pin to last-good and promote.
jamal: :thumbsup: quick check — is this in the mirror region or primary? if mirror lag, waiting 2-3 mins usually clears it.
maria: It retried automatically 2x then paused. we saw similar earlier where the index write committed after the registry returned 202 but the index cron lagged.
devops-lead: options: 1) manual promote using last-good image (safe, need release notes update), 2) force ci rerun (costly/time), 3) short hold (5-10m) then rerun if still missing.
alyssa: how fresh is last-good? deploy history shows webui:sha256:aa9f77 promoted in canary 1h ago. regression risk seems low.
jamal: If we manual-promote, we should append a note: "promoted previous artifact due to transient registry index propagation; follow-up: investigate index CRON lag". Also need an approver.
srebot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0421. Tagging infra-team.
maria: I'm +1 for manual promote to unblock the change window. we can schedule a dedicated rerun after the window if we still want the new build.
devops-lead: Accepting recommendation. I'll perform the manual promote and update release notes. tagging @maria @jamal for quick review.
devops-lead: manual promote command: `deployctl promote --artifact webui@sha256:aa9f77 --target=stable --reason "index propagation; smoke flake"`
jamal: ran the promote dry-run, looks good. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by devops-lead. New stable tag points to webui@sha256:aa9f77.
alyssa: thanks — release window unblocked. I'll add a short note to the release notes and create a follow-up ticket to investigate registry index commit+cron race.
maria: leaving an action: rerun the full CI for the new build after the window and if green, we can decide whether to promote again or keep the pinned artifact.
alyssa: agreed. closing thread for now. :rocket:
